`torchdata . datapipes . iter . IterDataPipe `: This is the base class for all iterable data pipes in torchdata
`torchdata . datapipes . iter . Mapper `: This data pipe applies a function to each element in the input data pipe
`torchdata . datapipes . iter . Filter `: This data pipe filters out elements from the input data pipe based on a condition
`torchdata . datapipes . iter . Shuffler `: This data pipe shuffles the elements in the input data pipe
`torchdata . datapipes . iter . Batcher `: This data pipe batches elements from the input data pipe into fixed -size groups
